title: Draft: Proto: Keep track of helper pinos in the parent
description:
For large files with unknown traffic on non-standard ports, `dissector_try_heuristic` is called a lot. That in turn calls `proto_is_protocol_enabled`, that has to check if a protocol is "in name only" every time, so that it can get the `is_enabled` property from the parent.

By inverting the relationship (storing the list of children in the parent), we can update `is_enabled` and `enabled_by_default` every time the parent is updated, and simplify `proto_is_protocol_enabled` a lot.

The performance improvement is small, but noticeable.

The obvious and bigger improvement would be avoid calling `dissector_try_heuristic` so often, but I'm not sure how we can do that.

I marked the MR as draft to collect ideas and suggestions, and because I'm not sure if this change can break something else.


While looking at the code, I also noticed that many functions in proto.c don't check input parameters (`proto_is_protocol_enabled_by_default` is one example), potentially leading to null pointer dereferencing. `proto_is_protocol_enabled` does it, so I kept the check. Shall we add an explicit check to the other functions? Or maybe `DISSECTOR_ASSERT`?
